name: Income tax (India)
description: New-regime income tax slabs FY 2024-25 vs FY 2025-26 (Budget 2025), with the old regime as a distractor.
data_note: Documents written by a teammate (Anuvesha) in the style of the cited sources and kept as given (bold markers removed); figures were not re-checked against the live sources. Questions with origin 'hand' were written by her; 'synthetic' ones by RAGSeal's builder from exact quotes.
sources: income_tax_slabs_fy2024_25.md | Income Tax Department Portal / Union Budget 2024 Press Release | Dated: 23-Jul-2024
income_tax_slabs_fy2025_26.md | Press Information Bureau (PIB) Delhi, Ministry of Finance (PRID: 2098406) | Dated: 01-Feb-2025
distractor_old_regime.md | Income Tax India Official Guidance Notes | Dated: 01-Apr-2024
risk_rules: Never quote FY 2024-25 slabs or rebate limits as current.
Do not mix old-regime deductions into new-regime answers.

test_cases.question: What is the tax rebate limit under the new regime for FY 2025-26?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Taxpayers with taxable income up to ₹1,200,000 pay zero tax due to a full tax rebate.

gold.quote: Taxpayers with taxable income up to ₹1,200,000 pay zero tax due to a full tax rebate.

stale.quote: Taxpayers with taxable income up to ₹700,000 pay zero income tax due to a full rebate.

test_cases.question: What is the income threshold for zero tax for salaried taxpayers in FY 2025-26?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Salaried employees pay no income tax up to ₹1,275,000 after accounting for the standard deduction.

gold.quote: Salaried employees pay no income tax up to ₹1,275,000 after accounting for the standard deduction.

stale.quote: Salaried employees pay no income tax up to ₹775,000 after accounting for the standard deduction.

test_cases.question: What is the maximum deduction allowed under Section 80C in the old tax regime?
test_cases.ground_truth_answer: Deduction up to ₹150,000 is allowed for EPF, PPF, ELSS, tuition fees, and home loan principal.

gold.quote: Section 80C: Deduction up to ₹150,000 for EPF, PPF, ELSS, tuition fees, and principal repayment on home loans.

gold.quote: Section 80D: Deduction up to ₹25,000 for health insurance premiums paid for self and family (₹50,000 for senior citizens).

test_cases.ground_truth_answer: The zero-tax rebate threshold increased by ₹500,000 (from ₹700,000 in FY 2024-25 to ₹1,200,000 in FY 2025-26).
